note.p: See Ed Pope's notes: Otley appeared 7 times between 1790 and 1792 always with Holcroft and mostly with known musicians (Clementi, Shield, Bosse). On 6.7.1792 Godwin listed 8 guests at Holcroft's and added 'quartets' - all the other 7 can be shown to be professional or amateur musicians which suggests Otley was a musician too Henry Otley shoemaker of Cranbourn Alley will PCC 1771 widow Elizabeth; 1773 Henry Otley appr to Matthew Wall hosier and glover St Anne Soho; E and M Otley haberdashers Cranbourn St 1781-7; Henry Otley hosier Cranbourn St voted Rodney and Lincoln 1780; Henry Otley marr Mary Bird St Ann Soho; Edward John Otley son of Henry and Mary St Ann Soho; Henry Otley hosier 7 Sidneys Alley St Anns voted Hood 1788, Fox and Tooke 1796; Fox and Gardner 1802; Paull 1806; Hy O jr appr to Hy O Sidneys Alley 1805; Hy O signed petition 1808 along with T Wishart calling for enquiry; Henry Otley will PCC 1835 of 24 Brompton Row wife Mary (will PCC 1843), sons Henry (will PCC 1838), Thomas Watson, Edward John (will PCC 1857 publisher of Conduit St, Han Sq), Charles, dau Mary wife of Charles Brown of Brompton, niece Amelia Woodhouse, son Frederick, sister Ann Otley of Manor Pl, Chelsea and her dau Ann George and (P)richard Otley (brothers) woollen drapers and men's mercers Holborn and Bond Street 1774-90+ subscr to Ignatius Sancho 1782 William O Esq, Drury O Esq, Miss O, Mrs M O, Miss S O; Drury O 1784 Clarges St, St Geo Han Sq; subscr to Maty's Sermons 1788 Drury, Adam and Thomas O; Boyle's 1792 Drury O Esq 49 Charlotte St, Rathbone Pl; Drury O Esq 10 Brianston St
We have not coded the 1815 and 1834 Otley under this name.
